title: Confluence
description: Sync Confluence Cloud spaces, pages, and users into Port

configurations.name: confluenceHostUrl
configurations.description: Confluence Cloud site URL, for example https://example.atlassian.net

configurations.name: confluenceUserEmail
configurations.description: Email of the Atlassian account used to read Confluence. The account must be able to view the spaces, pages, and users you want in Port.

configurations.name: confluenceApiToken
configurations.description: API token for that Atlassian account. Create one at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens
